sentence: This project studies how a membrane lipid called phosphatidylserine affects Polycystin signaling in the primary cilium.
This project studies how uncontrolled developmental programs can cause congenital defects and adult diseases, including cancer.
This project offers mass spectrometry tools to analyze the proteins in cells and how those proteins interact with other molecules.
This project builds a system that uses human-derived 3D cell systems, sensors and AI to model neural functions instead of animal behavior studies.
This project builds a way to predict emotional disorder symptoms using machine learning on measures that change over time.
This project tests whether gene therapy can help a gap in a rat thigh bone fill in with bone.
This project uses proteomics to find plasma proteins and immune cell proteins linked to cognitive decline after intracerebral hemorrhage.
This project studies how alcohol use in adolescence leads to lasting pain sensitivity in adults, looking at amygdala circuits.
This project tries to find out how endothelial cells in the lung regenerate and repair vascular damage in inflammatory lung injury.
This project studies how chromatin plasticity limits the effect of DNA methyltransferase inhibitor therapy in colon cancer.
This project builds computer methods that assemble many samples of RNA data to identify transcripts and annotate gene structures.
This project studies how glioblastoma tumors growing in the brain respond to treatment, to develop more effective therapies.
This project builds a machine learning model that predicts stroke, heart attack, heart failure and death using transfer regression.
This project studies how peptides affect a receptor that can regulate cholesterol level, aiming to develop treatments for Niemann-Pick Type C.
This project develops a way to measure blood pressure waves from the finger and uses artificial intelligence to find biomarkers of cardiometabolic disease.
This project studies why Ewing sarcoma resists a combination of trabectedin and irinotecan, aiming to develop combination therapies with less toxicity.
This project tests whether optical coherence tomography can see inside the human inner ear to help diagnose hearing loss and dizziness.
This project tries to find a stimulatory immune checkpoint that helps macrophages guard against tumors.
This project builds molecular tools to study viral DNA in primary cells and how it relates to oropharyngeal cancer.
This project supplies fibroblasts from diverse mammals and virus stocks, then tests how alpha and flavivirus infections vary across them.
